title: Restore and Verify Content
description: Progress from an intuitive model to the source implementation and its operational boundary: Restore and Verify Content.
learning_objectives: Explain restore and verify content using a plain-language model
Trace the source implementation for restore and verify content
Assess failure and operational limits of restore and verify content
concepts_covered: Restore loads the manifest, decrypts each referenced chunk, and concatenates them in order.
OpenRepository loads persisted state; Restore iterates chunk metadata and opens stored chunk bytes.
practical_outcomes: Explain at least one operational boundary
completion_criteria: Complete all three lessons and exercise
Score at least 7/10 on the assessment
